## Summary

Describe the user or scientific problem and the change made.

## Evidence and compatibility

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Core tests require no API key and no network access.
- [ ] Schema changes include compatibility and migration notes.
- [ ] New rules include both failing and nearby passing fixtures.
- [ ] Public examples contain only synthetic or redistributable artifacts.
- [ ] No unpublished, identifying, confidential, or proprietary data is included.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and any checks that could not be completed.
